map.和税收乘数？: How Does It Relate to the Tax Multiplier?
map.税收乘数=−MPC/(1−MPC)，符号相反，因减税先增可支配收入再消费。结果仅: Tax multiplier = −MPC/(1−MPC), with the opposite sign because a tax cut first raises disposable income and then spending.
